2026 Verification & Math Transparency

How POD Profit Calc Works (2026 Formula & Worked Example)

When to use this tool: Use this tool to price an individual Print-on-Demand product (tee, hoodie, mug, poster) on Etsy, Shopify, or TikTok Shop—including the impact of shop coupons and Printify Premium’s ~20% blank discount. For comparing Printify vs. Printful monthly totals side-by-side, use our Printify vs. Printful Calculator.

Exact Formula: Discounted Gross = Retail Price × (1 − Coupon %) + Buyer Shipping. Channel Fee = 9.5% + $0.45 (Etsy), 2.9% + $0.30 (Shopify), or 6.0% (TikTok). Standard Net = Gross − Channel Fee − Blank Cost − Supplier Ship. Premium Break-Even = ceil($29 ÷ (Blank Cost × 20%)).

Worked 2026 Example: $28.99 Graphic Tee at 10% Off + $4.99 Shipping on Etsy

  • Customer pays $31.08 total. Etsy deducts $3.40 (10.9%), standard POD blank ($11.40) + supplier shipping ($4.75) leaves $11.53 net profit (37.1% margin).
  • Switching to Printify Premium trims blank cost ~20% ($2.28 saved per shirt), lifting profit to $13.81/order and paying off the $29/mo subscription at just 13 shirts/month.

Frequently Asked Questions (POD Profit Calc)

What is a healthy profit margin for Print-on-Demand in 2026?

Aim for at least $7–$12 net profit per apparel item (25%–35% net margin before paid ads) so seasonal 15% sales or Etsy Offsite Ads never push an order underwater.

When does upgrading to Printify Premium make financial sense?

Because Printify Premium ($29/mo) discounts blank costs by up to 20% (~$2.00–$3.50 saved per shirt/hoodie), sellers typically break even at just 11 to 14 orders per month.

Should I offer free shipping on POD listings or charge $4.99 separately?

On Etsy, charging $24.99 + $4.99 shipping protects your margin during 20% shop sales because coupons discount only the $24.99 item price rather than the $4.99 postage.

Does POD supplier cost include sales tax if I do not have a resale certificate?

Yes—until you submit a state resale certificate to Printify or Printful, suppliers may charge US sales tax on the blank garment based on the buyer’s shipping state, adding ~$0.80–$1.20 per order.
